newsitem.title: CHINA: Siemens in China power plant venture.
newsitem.headline: Siemens in China power plant venture.

text.p: Germany's Siemens AG will have a 40 percent stake in a 11.4 billion yuan ($1.37 billion) thermal power plant venture in China's northern province of Hebei, a company official said on Friday.
The remaining 60 percent would be held by North China Power Group, Hebei Investment Corp and Hebei Electric Power Corp, Wei Ping, the China unit of Siemens said by telephone.
The partners would sign an agreement in Beijing later on Friday to set up a joint venture company, he said.
Siemens would provide two 660-megawatt generators, he said. The first and second units would begin operation 45 and 53 months respectively after the agreement goes into effect.
Foster Wheeler Corp of the United States would also provide the plant with boiler equipment, he said.
